d: Three games, three draws and everything still to play for. D Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov have made an intriguing start to their World Chess Championship battle in Geneva, but the scoreline does not tell the entire story. Gukesh came into the contest as the underdog against a higher-rated opponent, yet the Indian grandmaster has shown composure, preparation and the ability to withstand pressure. Today, Rupha Ramani looks at how Gukesh has approached the World Chess Championship match and why these early draws could mean much more than they suggest.
